scope: Only business_inventory.py plus new tests and these evidence files. No schema/API-registry/right changes, existing endpoint changes, PostgreSQL service, native build or deployment.
feature_publication: Existing business_api.capabilities aggregates the inventory module FEATURES only when that module is supported; checked through real authenticated Flask requests.

query.project_id: Optional nonempty 32 lowercase hexadecimal ID; omitted means existing global inventory.read scope.
query.after: Optional nonempty 32 lowercase hexadecimal keyset boundary, exclusive. No existence requirement; it is not an authorization token.
query.limit: Optional canonical decimal string 1..200; default100. Domain also accepts exact int, not bool/float.
query.validation: Unknown, duplicate, multivalued, empty or malformed query values are rejected. Normal transport query_data rejects duplicate keys.

response.next_after: Last emitted id only when another eligible row exists; otherwise null

selection: Active JSON boolean true and kind material/machine only, ascending id. Filter before LIMIT limit+1. Only explicit safe JSON keys selected, no raw payload or pricing/BOM JSON returned even for owner.
authorization: Fresh inventory.read via existing Domain.access before and after selection; supplied project also requires current project visibility/assignment. Existing global denials override scoped allows. No new grants or role defaults.

errors.400: Malformed or unrecognized query and invalid direct dispatch input.
errors.401: Missing/invalid session or missing/deactivated current user.
errors.403: Missing or withdrawn inventory.read. Finance endpoints remain403 for technician warehouse user.
errors.404: Supplied project missing or not currently assigned/visible.
errors.405: Method other than GET. HTTP Allow is GET.
errors.500: Invalid non-string safe catalogue fields; no raw payload is returned.

transport_boundary: GET request bodies follow the pre-existing generic transport behavior; inventory/articles is not added to business_api.strict_workflow_path in this owner scope. Direct dispatch rejects extra body keys, but HTTP body rejection would need a separate central transport change.

validation.test_environment: Fresh temporary SQLite fixtures, actual password/MFA/auth/domain code. No production DB, provider, message or external call.

initial_test_fixture_correction: First setup lacked required synthetic customer names (15 setup errors); fixed only new tests, retained original log. Then missing-route/method regression was recorded before product implementation.

provenance.source: PR8 reference endpoint idea inspected; current implementation adds strict direct query channel validation and safe field type checks.
